_comment: Global configuration for the Talent Inbox Automation system. Fill in all TODO values before deploying.
_ai_enabled_comment: HARD BLOCKER — set to false to prevent ALL OpenAI API calls. Triage and reply drafting are skipped entirely. Inbox syncing still runs. Only set to true when Colin explicitly re-enables AI.
_auto_send_enabled_comment: Auto-send list is now derived from sop.md (Auto Send: yes/no per talent). No longer a separate list here.
_spam_sweep_enabled_comment: Set to true to re-enable spam folder scanning. Drafts replies to score=3 emails caught by Gmail spam filter, leaving them untouched in Spam. Paused 2026-05-27 pending Marco review.

openai._triage_model_comment: Use gpt-4o-mini for triage (cheaper, nearly as accurate). Switch to gpt-4o only if quality drops.
openai._reply_model_comment: Always use gpt-4o for reply drafting — quality matters here.
openai._temperature_comment: Low temperature for triage = consistent, deterministic scoring.

triage._global_minimum_rate_comment: Set to 0 to use per-talent minimums only. Override here to enforce a global floor across all inboxes.

never_reply._comment: Emails matching any rule here are immediately archived (Score 1) without calling GPT. Add senders/domains/keywords that should NEVER receive an auto-reply.
never_reply._senders_comment: Exact sender email addresses to block.

reply._draft_mode_comment: A real Gmail draft is ALWAYS created regardless of this flag (see poller.py). This flag now only gates the /send-all bulk-approve endpoint — true means send-all requires draft_mode=false to run (temporarily flipped 2026-07-31 ~04:20-04:45 UTC to clear Trinity's backlog, reverted here).
reply._send_delay_comment: Minutes to wait after drafting before sending. Only applies when draft_mode is false. Set to 0 to disable. Keep at 15 during Phase 2 testing.

digest._send_time_comment: TODO: Confirm exact time with supervisor.
digest._recipient_email_comment: TODO: Fill in supervisor email address (or comma-separated list for multiple recipients).
digest.subject_template: Daily Inbox Report — {{DATE}} — {{TOTAL}} emails processed, {{NEEDS_REVIEW}} need review

google_sheets._master_log_sheet_id_comment: Master Activity Log Google Sheet (provided 2026-04-17). Tab name: 'Master Log'.
google_sheets._sop_matrix_sheet_id_comment: TODO: Paste the Google Sheet ID for the SOP matrix. See sheets/sop_data.json for the full SOP data already extracted from the uploaded XLSX.

make._workspace_zone_comment: TODO: Confirm your Make workspace zone (us1, eu1, etc.).
make._error_alert_email_comment: TODO: Email address to receive immediate error alerts when a Make scenario fails or OAuth expires.

guardian._comment: Self-healing watchdog — all thresholds tunable without redeploy
guardian._sender_talent_key_comment: Talent whose Gmail OAuth token is used to send Guardian alert emails. Must have an active token in the DB.
guardian._global_draft_hard_limit_comment: Raised from 200 on 2026-09-04: a 200-draft backlog flush after an outage is normal recovery, not a runaway. Breaching this no longer kills AI on its own — the drafts-per-email ratio must also exceed draft_email_ratio_warn, since a runaway drafts repeatedly for the same email while catch-up drafts once per queued email.

reply_to_routing._comment: SOP v16 Part 3 — Reply-To Routing List. Sets the Reply-To HEADER on drafts/replies. Header-only routing: never added to the email body, never mentioned in the draft, From address unchanged. Matching is on the TALENT INBOX (the alias the brand emailed, per single_inbox.alias_map — NOT the receiving account, since 13 talents now share talent-mgmt@taboost.me), never on the sender. A talent in no group gets no Reply-To, per Part 3's closing line.
reply_to_routing._deviation_from_sop: sop.md Part 3 lists a third group, creator-mgmt@taboost.me, for Mahogany / Anastasiya / Jenn / Grayson / BKuhl. That mailbox has been retired, so the group is DELIBERATELY not mirrored here — pointing Reply-To at a dead address would send brand replies nowhere, which is worse than the no-Reply-To behaviour those five have had all along. They keep getting no Reply-To until sop.md Part 3 is corrected by an SOP owner. Do not add the group back without confirming the mailbox exists.

single_inbox._comment: SOP v16 consolidated inbox routing. These 15 talent aliases route to talent-mgmt@taboost.me. The automation identifies the correct talent from the original recipient header (Delivered-To / X-Original-To / Envelope-To / To), NOT from which Gmail account received the email. The four Partnerships talents are deliberately absent — they poll their own accounts, see reply_to_routing.
single_inbox._alias_map_comment: alias email → talent_key. Each value MUST match a 'Key:' in sheets/sop.md exactly; main.py warns at startup if one does not.

stall_alarm._comment: Pipeline stall watchdog. Alarms on the ABSENCE of expected work — the scheduler logs jobs as 'executed successfully' even when they throw, so error-based monitoring missed the 2026-09-03 and 2026-08-04 outages entirely.

claim_reaper._comment: Resolves expired auto_send claims by asking Gmail what actually happened, rather than clearing them blindly — a worker can die AFTER Gmail accepts a send, and a blind retry would send a brand a duplicate reply. Only two outcomes are actioned: Gmail draft still exists (nothing sent -> release the claim) or the thread carries a SENT message (it did send -> record it). Anything else is left for a human.
